newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Japanese men arrested in Australia on drug charges.
newsitem.headline: Japanese men arrested in Australia on drug charges.

text.p: Australian police said on Saturday they had arrested two Japanese men in connection with the seizure of 4.2 kgs (9.26 lbs) of heroin at Sydney airport.
The two men, aged 50 and 51, were arrested on Friday night after customs officers found the drugs on their bodies.
A police spokeswoman said police had now made three arrests after multiple heroin seizures over the past two days.
"The drug seizures have yielded about 6.2 kgs (13.67 lbs)of high grade heroin with an estimated street value of A$6.0 million (US$4.68 million)," the spokeswoman said in a statement.
A 47-year-old Japanese man was arrested on Thursday after 2.0 kgs (4.41 lbs) of heroin was found on his body.
The three men appeared in a Sydney court earlier on Saturday and were remanded in custody to re-appear on Monday.
